facts.fact: SUV 里 Ben 递出红礼盒：1920s 欧式切工 art deco 戒指——「不需要现在回答，这是我 concrecte 的承诺」。
facts.anchor: He takes out a small, red gift box and holds it out.

facts.fact: 新任务：Gibbons 六小时前再次穿越，从 Allen 宅的镜子直达 1938——二战前夜，他在谋划大事。
facts.anchor: “1938,” Burke says in his deep, reverberating voice. So fitting, since the year rings in all of our heads.

facts.fact: 镜子仓库真相：Quint 从 1929 到 1938 每年买四面镜子（一季一面）——他在等她回来，直到放弃结婚。
facts.anchor: Quint Allen bought four mirrors a year from 1929 to 1938. One every season.

facts.fact: Clara 的震动：她对 Quint 的爱比她承认的大得多——「他相信我会回来」。
facts.anchor: That piece of me—much larger than I’ve led myself to believe—swells and lodges itself in my throat.

facts.fact: 十年后的 Quint：方下巴、络腮胡、黑 dinner jacket——「but his eyes are still honey brown」。
facts.anchor: He’s taller, at least by a few inches, and his shoulders are much broader.

facts.fact: 引荐客人时 Clara 与 Quint 同时说出「Fiancée」——Catherine Pratt 已在厅中（1938 年订婚）。
facts.anchor: “Fiancée,” I whisper the same time Quint finishes his sentence on the same word.

facts.fact: 楼梯偶遇：Quint 以为全家都在英国——客厅的「冷淡客气」底下是 falseness，Clara 读得出来。
facts.anchor: “Can’t say I expected to come down the stairs and see you two.

facts.fact: Mrs. Barrow 楼梯八卦：Quint 从没忘过 Clara（「sweet on you」）、Catherine 不许她跟去英国、每年夏天见 Catherine 却拖了这么多年才求婚。
facts.anchor: “I know I’m quite impertinent—the Allens always tell me so

facts.fact: Mrs. Barrow 的话勾起 Quint 在 1928 说过的话——「我一直知道你有主见」，熟悉与爱慕的记忆重现。
facts.anchor: I have always known you had your own mind.

facts.fact: 章末：Clara 用冥想赶不走的念头——一睡着 Quint 就进入她的梦。
facts.anchor: My mind betrays me, however, because the second I fall asleep, Quint joins me in my dreams.
